annotation.title_clean: Report 510: Inquiry into the use and governance of artificial intelligence systems by public sector entities - 'Proceed with Caution'
annotation.title_en: Report 510: Inquiry into the use and governance of artificial intelligence systems by public sector entities - 'Proceed with Caution'
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Joint Committee of Public Accounts and Audit, Parliament of Australia
annotation.summary_en: Landing page for the Australian Joint Committee of Public Accounts and Audit's Report 510 on AI use in the public sector, reproducing its recommendations: an APS census on AI use, a whole-of-government working group on standalone AI legislation and mandatory rules, a statutory parliamentary AI committee, and clearer AI definitions in guidance.
key_provisions_or_claims: Add AI-use and understanding questions to the annual APS Employee Census
Convene a whole-of-government working group within 12 months to consider standalone AI legislation and mandatory public sector rules
AI systems must not be used for surveillance of public sector staff; set thresholds for AI involvement in decisions
Establish a statutory Joint Committee on AI and Emerging Technologies with approval powers over related legislation and rules
DTA guidance should clearly define AI systems, with separate guidance for each technology
